activity_summary: You looked along the nave from the pew. Anne and your mother were at the end of it, their backs to you, in the green light off the river side. A cuff on the nearer wrist was still undone. No child's face was in it, and the churchyard was not in it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: attendee in The nave, from the pew

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood at the end of the pew, her back to the frame.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood beside her. The undone cuff was on the nearer wrist.
